cd /app/work && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
random.seed(11)
P1, R1, D1 = 2, 2, 1
inputs2 = [[[3],[5]],[[7],[11]]]
n = 12000
states = [{"delivered": [[], [[]]], "slots": []} for s in range(n)]
edges = []
seen = set()
for i in range(n):
    edges.append([i, "ring", (i+1) % n])
i = 0
while len(edges) < 60000:
    u = random.randrange(n); v = random.randrange(n)
    a = "ch%d" % (i % 16); i += 1
    if (u,a,v) in seen: continue
    seen.add((u,a,v)); edges.append([u,a,v])
fair = []
for i in range(16):
    if i % 2:
        fair.append({"action": "ch%d" % ((i*37) % 16), "mode": "strong"})
    else:
        fair.append({"action": "ch%d" % ((i*5+3) % 16), "mode": "weak"})
req = {"op":"audit","inputs":inputs2,"states":states,"edges":edges,"start":0,"fairness":fair}
data = json.dumps(req).encode()
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/app/submission/main.py"], input=data+b"\n",
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=300)
print("rc", p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:800])
print("time %.2f" % (time.time()-t0))
print(p.stdout[:300])
PYEOF
